notes: «أبي - رحمه الله - قال» : the compiler's father, a bare relation; the blessing is not part of the surface; the compiler is added by the tool
«عن عبد الله عليه السلام» is the Imam after «عن» in the chain: a narrator link (owner ruling 2); «وقال: من بركة المرأة» continues the saying with no isnad of its own, so it is one route
